entries.title: Engine temp sensor transfer map
entries.description: this is map used to tranfer values of engine temperature sensor to the ECU, value 0 means "enrich a lot" 255 means "no enrichment"

entries.title: Map Address INDEX in the code
entries.description: read first 4 bytes that is the hex address withing the bin file of the first map, it is 4C00 then 4C06... and so on. This can be used to manipulate with map location and many other things, only for advanced user

entries.title: AFM voltage transfer map
entries.description: Don't touch this, this map is used to tell the DME the load of the AFM

entries.title: AFM map scale factors (injector size adjusting)
entries.description: use this map for adjusting for different MAF or different size injectors. Lower value is lowers injector pulse time

entries.title: Rev Limit(primary)
entries.description: Do not adjust past 7000

entries.title: Rev Limit buffer(primary)
entries.description: 3x40= 120rpm after rev limit to totaly shut down injectors. When DME hits rev limit it cuts few injectors and then if the revs still don't drop down this value is used to cut all injectors at one. So value in DEC 3 means 3x40=120aditional RPM

entries.title: Rev Limit buffer(secondary)
entries.description: 3x40= 120rpm after rev limit to totaly shut down injectors. When DME hits rev limit it cuts few injectors and then if the revs still don't drop down this value is used to cut all injectors at one. So value in DEC 3 means 3x40=120aditional RPM

entries.title: Checksum 16bit
entries.description: looks like checksum is located at the last two bytes of the code at 7FFD and that makes it 16bit value
